peaceful.dialogue.chat: Hello, %1$s. Take your time — I'm not going anywhere.
peaceful.dialogue.chat/1: Welcome. Sit with me a while, if you like. The day's kind today.
peaceful.dialogue.chat/2: It's good to see you. Say what's on your mind, and say it slowly.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations: A real conversation. I'd like that very much, %1$s. Let's take it gently.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations/1: Of course. There's time enough for anything worth saying.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations/2: Gladly. I find these talks settle me as much as they settle anyone.
Calm, thank you. The mornings have been still and the work has been kind. That's all I ask of a week.
Good. Nothing dramatic — the garden grew, the sun came, I slept well. It's enough.
Quiet and steady. I've learned to be grateful for weeks like this one.
Unsettled, if I'm honest. I've been trying to sit with it rather than fight it. That helps, mostly.
A harder week. It will pass — they always do. Thank you for asking, %1$s.
You've asked already, %1$s. The answer is the same. I don't change much between mornings.
Still well. I'd tell you plainly if I weren't.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.day.good: A gentle day. I watched the light move across the wall for a while and didn't feel guilty about it.
Good. The work was quiet and the afternoon was warm. I want nothing more than that.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.day.roug: A difficult one. I've been out by the water since — it puts things back in proportion.
Not an easy day. But the evening's coming, and evenings are forgiving things.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.work.lik: I do. There's a rhythm to it, and when I find that rhythm the hours pass like water.
Yes. Honest work, done carefully, is its own kind of quiet. I've come to value that.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.work.hat: Only when it's rushed. Hurry takes the good out of anything, %1$s — even work you'd otherwise love.
It's not the work. It's the noise around it. I'd like it far better in silence.
%2$s, yes. It's a gentle place, and gentle places are rarer than people realise.
I've made my peace with %2$s and it with me. That's what home is, I think.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.people.f: They're good, and they're trying. That's true of most people, if you give them room to show it.
I'm fond of them. I don't need them to be anything other than what they are.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.food.fir: Something simple, eaten slowly, ideally outdoors. Bread and fruit and no particular hurry.
Whatever's in season, prepared plainly. Food doesn't need to be clever to be good.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.life.fir: It's not a dramatic story, %1$s, but it's been a good one. I'll tell it gladly if you've the time.
Some hard years early on, and a long calm since. I'm grateful for the calm.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.dreams.f: Nothing to chase, honestly. To stay as I am, near people I care for. That would do very well.
A quiet life that stays quiet. I know how that sounds. I've wanted louder things and liked them less.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.fears.fi: Bitterness. I've watched it take good people slowly, and they never saw it happening.
Losing my calm and not being able to find it again. It took me long enough the first time.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.feelings: You're easy to be near, %1$s. I don't have to hold anything steady when you're here — it just is.
There's a quiet I only get in certain company. You're that company.
That deserves a fuller answer than I can give today. Ask me again when we've more time, %1$s.
Not yet — not out of secrecy. Some things want the right moment, and this isn't it.
That's a still-water question, and I'd want to answer it well. Give it time and you'll have it.
You're asking gently, and I appreciate that. I'm still not ready. Soon, perhaps.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.n: Nothing at all, and I'm glad of it. A week with no news is a week where nobody was hurt.
No news. I've never much minded a dull week — they're kinder than the interesting ones.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.us.happy: Yes, %1$s. Deeply, and without any noise about it. That's the kind that lasts.
I am. You brought me a stillness I didn't know I was missing.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.m: %2$s and %3$s were married. A gentle ceremony, and the whole square felt lighter for it.
%2$s and %3$s wed this week. I wish them the long quiet kind of happiness. It's the best sort.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.d: %2$s and %3$s have parted. It was handled kindly, from what I saw. That matters more than people credit.
%2$s and %3$s separated. Sad, but not bitter — and I'm thankful for that much.
%2$s has passed on, %1$s. I sat with them near the end. It was peaceful. I hope that's some comfort.
We lost %2$s. Grief takes the time it takes. Don't let anyone hurry you through it.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.b: %2$s has been born. A new life in the village — the whole place feels softer for a while after.
There's a new one among us: %2$s. Small and perfectly unbothered by any of it. Lovely.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.a: %2$s has come to live here. I've left them be for now — arriving somewhere new is tiring enough.
A newcomer, %2$s. They'll find their footing. Everyone does, given room.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.d: %2$s has moved on. I hope the next place is kind to them. We part with people all our lives.
%2$s left for good. I'll miss them quietly, which is how I miss most things.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.confused: I didn't quite catch that. Take your time.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Say it again, gently. I'm in no hurry.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.hint: Ask me about %2$s, if you like.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: %2$s would be a good place to start.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.shrug: I don't know. That's all right too.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/1: No answer for that one. Some things keep.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.dropped: I've lost the thread. Begin again whenever.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.busy: I'm in the middle of something. A little while yet.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.muted: Of course. Quiet is easy company.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: I'll say nothing. It's no trouble.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.farewell: Go well, %1$s. Come back when you like.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Safe travels. The door stays open.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.insult: I'll let that pass. No good comes of answering it.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: That wasn't kind. I'll leave it be.
peaceful.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Ah — you're here. Sit a while if you want.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.day.roug: It is. You've a way of letting a thing be difficult without needing to solve it. That's a gift.
The wood, then. Tuesday. There's no hurry in it; we'll go at whatever pace the day allows.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.work.fol: ...It is. It's good to be seen whole rather than as a pair of hands.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.fears.op: You'll stand with me. Then I'm less afraid of it already, which seems too easy but there it is.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.hopes.re: You waited. Silence is where most true things get said, and you left room for it.
peaceful.dialogue.conversations.life.rev: You asked about my life once. It's been settling since, the way water does.
